## Seeded runs

The four primary chronologies and the ²¹⁰Pb sensitivity are refitted
with `Rscript R/run_all.R --age-models`; every run is seeded and
recorded in a manifest that the test `R/tests/test_bacon_provenance.R`
checks against the stored files.

**Bacon runs behind the chronologies.**

| Model | Role | Seed | rbacon | Control file | Posterior file | Generated |
|:---|:---|---:|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| JayBath | primary | 42 | 3.5.2 | Cores/JayBath/JayBath.csv | Cores/JayBath/JayBath_28.out | 2026-11-09 15:43:36 UTC |
| LogWallow | primary | 42 | 3.5.2 | Cores/LogWallow/LogWallow.csv | Cores/LogWallow/LogWallow_17.out | 2026-11-09 15:43:36 UTC |
| ReflectionPond | primary | 42 | 3.5.2 | Cores/ReflectionPond/ReflectionPond.csv | Cores/ReflectionPond/ReflectionPond_15.out | 2026-11-09 15:43:36 UTC |
| PantherPotholes | primary | 42 | 3.5.2 | Cores/PantherPotholes/PantherPotholes.csv | Cores/PantherPotholes/PantherPotholes_169.out | 2026-11-09 15:43:36 UTC |
| PantherPotholes_pb210err | configured +-10-year 210Pb sensitivity | 42 | 3.5.2 | Cores/PantherPotholes_pb210err/PantherPotholes_pb210err.csv | Cores/PantherPotholes_pb210err/PantherPotholes_pb210err_169.out | 2026-11-09 15:43:36 UTC |
